name: Herrsche
source:
Laste and Luna's superior.
The most ancient and powerful Demoness of all the Chaos Kin residing in the Tower.
She's usually calm and collected, but if she's upset she will kill and destroy anyone and anything, be it human or other Chaos Kin.

Her ability is "Disintegration". Anything target within her line of sight is disintegrated and reduced to dust.
